lines.text: This is Baton, recorded live: *one assistant*, on free AI keys.
Sign up with a username. It checks the name is free *as you type*.
Then add an AI. Free tiers are labelled, and *Automatic* picks the best one for each task.
Here we connect *our own server*. One click tests it.
Now just ask. The lead assistant brings in *an Analyst and a Critic*, and every step shows live.
The answer says *which AI replied, and why*.
Want something done every day? *Describe an agent in chat.*
Press Create, and it's ready, *on a schedule*.
The Agent Tree shows *how each agent works*: what starts it, its steps, its tools, and what you get.
And you stay in control. Actions that can't be undone are *blocked*, and Python asks first.
The run *waits for your yes*, then finishes.
Baton. *Pass every task to the right AI.*
